referenceFunction.generalComment: The module includes the use of energy and auxiliary materials for the operation of lighting, ventilation, heating, feeding system, slurry agitator and pump, cleaning, drinking water. The functional unit is 1 fattening pig place during 1 year.; UUID: 791f76a8-c83a-3fbe-8b5b-bc069157be73
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory takes into account the energy and auxiliary materials like water, lubricating oil and cleaning agents for the use of the described module for one year. Also included is the use of the infrastructure with the binding of a certain part of the appropriate infrastructure module. Not taken into account were the direct emission of the animal husbandry, fodder production and produced waste water.

geography.text: The inventory applies for Swiss agricultural buildings only, because of the solid method of construction.

technology.text: The use of energy and auxiliary materials are calculated for the conditions defined in the infrastructure-module with literature data and experts knowledge.

representativeness.productionVolume: Existing fully-slatted floor housing system for pig in Ch in 1996: 1706 units.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: In the use of energy and auxiliary materials are big differences between the farms. The inventory is based on mean values from CH and WEU.
